question: Isabel had sixteen bottles of water. After a week she had seven left. How many did she drink?
A waiter had eighteen customers. If six left, how many customers would the waiter still have?
Maria took sixteen fish out of her fish tank. Now there are three fish in the tank. How many fish were in the tank to start with?
A waiter had fourteen customers. After some left he still had three customers. How many customers left?
Cody had a bag of marbles. Later he gave five to his brother. Now Cody has seven marbles. How many marbles did Cody have to start with?
A chef used fifteen apples to make a pie. Now he has four apples left. How many apples did he have before he made the pie?
Megan gave seven acorns to her sister. Now Megan has nine acorns left. How many acorns did Megan have in the beginning?
A chef had fourteen apples. If he used eight of them to make a pie, how many apples would he still have?
Amy had twelve pencils. If she used four of them, how many would she have left?
Edward spent $13. Now he has $6. How much did Edward have before he spent his money?
Ned gave away thirteen of his video games to a friend. Now Ned has six games. How many games did Ned have before he gave the games away?
For a party Cody bought eleven cupcakes. After the party he had two left. How many were eaten at the party?
Frank got fifteen pounds of mushroom for family barbecue. If they ate eight pounds, how many pounds were left?
Kaleb has seventeen shirts. If he got rid of seven of them, how many shirts would Kaleb have?
While playing a game Edward had fifteen lives. He lost eight lives on a hard level. How many lives does he have left?
A group was sitting at a lunch table. After finishing, six people left and there were five left at the table. How many people were at the table to start with?
A clown had sixteen balloons. He gave four away at a party. How many balloons does he still have?
Haley grew sixteen trees in her backyard. After a typhoon five died. How many trees does she have left?
Debby owned thirteen DVDs. If she sold six of them, how many would she have left?
The host prepared nineteen cakes for the party. After the party he had nine left. How many cakes did people eat in the party?
Frank had thirteen boxes. If he filled eight with toys, how many boxes does he still have?
Olivia owned ninety-three pennies. After she bought an apple, she had fifty-six pennies left. How many did she spend for the apple?
A farmer had ninety-seven tomatoes from his garden. If he picked eighty-three of them, how many would he have left?
Paul had eighty-six books. After selling some in a garage sale he had seventy-eight left. How many books did he sell?
Isabel had some candy. She gave her friend twenty-seven pieces and had sixty-one left. How many pieces did she have to start with?
